NOAA CO-OPS responses (US Government work, public domain), recorded with curl
from https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov; no key is involved. Every file is
the response body byte for byte, except the stations_*.json files (below).
Times are UTC. The data API path is /api/prod/datagetter and every data
request also had
  &application=MetOceanViewer&time_zone=gmt&units=metric&format=json
(D = /api/prod/datagetter?, M = /mdapi/prod/webapi/).

Copied from docs/provider-apis/ (recorded 2026-10-06, metric):
  water_level.json        coops_water_level.json: water_level, 8729840, MSL
  predictions.json        coops_predictions.json: predictions, 8729840, 6 min
  datums.json             coops_datums.json (re-recorded 2026-10-15 16:49Z
                          from M stations/8729840/datums.json?units=metric:
                          byte-identical)
Not used: docs/provider-apis/coops_wind.json is in knots (units=english): its
speed 7.0 and gust 11.27 are 3.6 and 5.8 m/s in wind.json below.

Recorded 2026-10-15 16:49Z:
  water_level_igld.json   D product=water_level&station=9063020&datum=IGLD
                          &begin_date=20261001 00:00&end_date=20261001 00:12
  hourly_height.json      D product=hourly_height&station=8729840&datum=MLLW
                          &begin_date=20250101 00:00&end_date=20250101 03:00
  one_minute_water_level.json

  predictions_six_minute_navd.json

                          &interval=h&begin_date=20261001 00:00
                          &end_date=20261001 02:59
  wind.json               D product=wind&station=8729840
                          &begin_date=20261001 00:00&end_date=20261001 00:30
  wind_hourly.json        D product=wind&station=8729840&interval=h
                          &begin_date=20261001 00:00&end_date=20261001 02:59
  air_temperature.json, water_temperature.json, air_pressure.json
                          D product=<name>&station=8729840
                          &begin_date=20261001 00:00&end_date=20261001 00:12
  humidity.json, conductivity.json, salinity.json
                          D product=<name>&station=8419870 (same dates)
  visibility.json         D product=visibility&station=8575437 (same dates)
  air_gap.json            D product=air_gap&station=8517986 (same dates)
  air_gap_with_datum.json the same with &datum=MLLW: an identical body (the
                          API ignores datum and interval for air_gap)
  error_datum_missing.json
                          D product=water_level&station=8729840 (no datum)
                          &begin_date=20261001 00:00&end_date=20261001 00:12
  error_datum_invalid.json
                          the same with &datum=FOO
  error_datum_not_at_station.json
                          the same with &datum=IGLD
  error_no_predictions.json
                          D product=predictions&station=1610367 (subordinate)
                          &datum=MLLW&interval=6&begin_date=20261001 00:00
                          &end_date=20261001 02:59
  error_no_data.json      D product=one_minute_water_level&station=8311062
                          &datum=STND&begin_date=20261001 00:00

  error_station.json      D product=water_level&station=1234567&datum=MLLW

  gateway_error.json      D product=water_level&station=8729840&datum=MLLW
                          &begin_date=20261001 00:00&end_date=20261001 00:30:
                          one transient gateway failure (HTTP status not
                          recorded); the request repeated 40 s later gave
                          water_level_mllw.json
  datums_great_lakes.json M stations/9063020/datums.json?units=metric
  datums_null.json        M stations/8517986/datums.json?units=metric (an air

Trimmed station lists, recorded 2026-10-15 16:49Z and cut to a few stations
with a script that keeps every member of the envelope and of each kept
station and drops the other stations (json.dump, indent 1, so the bytes
differ from the response; "count" still gives the full list's size):
  stations_waterlevels.json  M stations.json?type=waterlevels
                             &expand=details,sensors: 1611400, 8729840,
                             8771972, 9063020 (of 302)
  stations_met.json          M stations.json?type=met&expand=details,sensors:
                             1617433, 8419870, 8575437, 8775302 ("details":
                             null), 9435373 ("sensors": null) (of 314)
  stations_airgap.json       M stations.json?type=airgap
                             &expand=details,sensors: 8517986, 8767931 (of 21)
  stations_tidepredictions.json
                             M stations.json?type=tidepredictions: 1610367
                             (type S), 1612340, 8218617 (integer lat),
                             8729840, TEC1603 (not a CO-OPS id) (of 3502)

their names, positions and dates agreed in every one):
